command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Continue'
Write-Output '--- ECC-Q-FORM (same query as the 01:24Z baseline) ---'
& nvidia-smi -i GPU-4f7d4396-9304-d12f-7e9b-7f04d1236fc2 -q -d ECC 2>&1 | Select-String -Pattern 'ECC Mode|Current|Pending|Volatile|Aggregate|Single Bit|Double Bit|Device Memory|Total' | ForEach-Object { $_.Line }

Write-Output '--- RC ---'
